text: I spent last Tuesday afternoon trying to fix the squeaky hinge on the back door, which mostly meant standing in the hallway with a can of WD-40 and a screwdriver, wondering why the previous owner had used three different screw heads on the same hinge. My neighbour came over halfway through, offered advice I didn't ask for, and left with my spare screws. The door still squeaks, but only when it rains now, which feels like progress of a sort.
